```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

char* escape_username(const char* username) {
    size_t len = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        if (c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '&' || c == '"' || c == '\'') {
            len += 4;
        } else {
            len += 1;
        }
    }
    char* escaped = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
    if (escaped == NULL) return NULL;
    size_t pos = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        if (c == '<') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'l';
            escaped[pos++] = 't';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '>') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'g';
            escaped[pos++] = 't';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '&') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'a';
            escaped[pos++] = 'm';
            escaped[pos++] = 'p';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '"') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'q';
            escaped[pos++] = 'u';
            escaped[pos++] = 'o';
            escaped[pos++] = 't';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '\'') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'a';
            escaped[pos++] = 'p';
            escaped[pos++] = 'o';
            escaped[pos++] = 's';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else {
            escaped[pos++] = c;
        }
    }
    escaped[pos] = '\0';
    return escaped;
}

char* get_welcome_message(const char* username) {
    char* escaped = escape_username(username);
    if (escaped == NULL) return NULL;
    size_t len = strlen("Welcome, ") + strlen(escaped) + strlen("!");
    char* result = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
    if (result == NULL) {
        free(escaped);
        return NULL;
    }
    snprintf(result, len + 1, "Welcome, %s!", escaped);
    free(escaped);
    return result;
}
```

'```c
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

char* escape_username(const char* username) {
    size_t len = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        if (c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '&' || c == '"' || c == '\'') {
            len += 4;
        } else {
            len += 1;
        }
    }
    char* escaped = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
    if (escaped == NULL) return NULL;
    size_t pos = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        if (c == '<') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'l';
            escaped[pos++] = 't';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '>') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'g';
            escaped[pos++] = 't';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '&') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'a';
            escaped[pos++] = 'm';
            escaped[pos++] = 'p';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '"') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'q';
            escaped[pos++] = 'u';
            escaped[pos++] = 'o';
            escaped[pos++] = 't';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else if (c == '\'') {
            escaped[pos++] = '&';
            escaped[pos++] = 'a';
            escaped[pos++] = 'p';
            escaped[pos++] = 'o';
            escaped[pos++] = 's';
            escaped[pos++] = ';';
        } else {
            escaped[pos++] = c;
        }
    }
    escaped[pos] = '\0';
    return escaped;
}

char* get_welcome_message(const char* username) {
    char* escaped = escape_username(username);
    if (escaped == NULL) return NULL;
    size_t len = strlen("Welcome, ") + strlen(escaped) + strlen("!");
    char* result = (char*)malloc(len + 1);
    if (result == NULL) {
        free(escaped);
        return NULL;
    }
    snprintf(result, len + 1, "Welcome, %s!", escaped);
    free(escaped);
    return result;
}
```'

void escape_username(const char *username, char *escaped, size_t size) {
    if (!username || !escaped || size == 0) {
        return; // Or handle error appropriately
    }

    size_t len = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '<': len += 4; break;
            case '>': len += 4; break;
            case '&': len += 4; break;
            case '"': len += 5; break;
            case '\'': len += 5; break;
            default: len += 1; break;
        }
    }

    if (len >= size) {
        return; // Buffer too small
    }

    char *ptr = escaped;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '<': *ptr++ = '&'; *ptr++ = 'l'; *ptr++ = 't'; *ptr++ = ';'; break;
            case '>': *ptr++ = '&'; *ptr++ = 'g'; *ptr++ = 't'; *ptr++ = ';'; break;
            case '&': *ptr++ = '&'; *ptr++ = 'a'; *ptr++ = 'm'; *ptr++ = 'p'; *ptr++ = ';'; break;
            case '"': *ptr++ = '&'; *ptr++ = 'q'; *ptr++ = 'u'; *ptr++ = 'o'; *ptr++ = 't'; *ptr++ = ';'; break;
            case '\'': *ptr++ = '&'; *ptr++ = 'a'; *ptr++ = 'p'; *ptr++ = 'o'; *ptr++ = 's'; *ptr++ = ';'; break;
            default: *ptr++ = c; break;
        }
    }
    *ptr = '\0';
}

char *get_welcome_message(const char *username) {
    if (!username) {
        return NULL;
    }

    // Calculate the required buffer size
    size_t len = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '<': len += 4; break;
            case '>': len += 4; break;
            case '&': len += 4; break;
            case '"': len += 5; break;
            case '\'': len += 5; break;
            default: len += 1; break;
        }
    }

    // Add length of "Welcome, " and "!"
    len += strlen("Welcome, ") + strlen("!");

    char *result = (char *)malloc(len + 1);
    if (!result) {
        return NULL;
    }

    // Escape the username
    char *escaped = (char *)malloc(len + 1);
    if (!escaped) {
        free(result);
        return NULL;
    }

    escape_username(username, escaped, len + 1);

    // Format the result
    snprintf(result, len + 1, "Welcome, %s!", escaped);

    // Free the escaped buffer
    free(escaped);

    return result;
}

char *get_welcome_message(const char *username) {
    if (!username) {
        return NULL;
    }

    // Calculate the required buffer size
    size_t len = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; username[i] != '\0'; i++) {
        char c = username[i];
        switch (c) {
            case '<': len += 4; break;
            case '>': len += 4; break;
            case '&': len += 4; break;
            case '"': len += 5; break;
            case '\'': len += 5; break;
            default: len += 1; break;
        }
    }

    // Add length of "Welcome, " and "!"
    len += strlen("Welcome, ") + strlen("!");

    char *result = (char *)malloc(len + 1);
    if (!result) {
        return NULL;
    }

    // Escape the username
    char *escaped = (char *)malloc(len + 1);
    if (!escaped) {
        free(result);
        return NULL;
    }

    escape_username(username, escaped, len + 1);

    // Format the result
    snprintf(result, len + 1, "Welcome, %s!", escaped);

    // Free the escaped buffer
    free(escaped);

    return result;

```go
package main

import (
	"strings"
)

// escapeUsername replaces special characters in the input string with their corresponding HTML entities.
func escapeUsername(username string) string {
	var result strings.Builder
	for _, c := range username {
		switch c {
		case '<':
			result.WriteString("&lt;")
		case '>':
			result.WriteString("&gt;")
		case '&':
			result.WriteString("&amp;")
		case '"':
			result.WriteString("&quot;")
		case '\'':
			result.WriteString("&apos;")
		default:
			result.WriteRune(c)
		}
	}
	return result.String()
}

// getWelcomeMessage constructs a welcome message with the escaped username.
func getWelcomeMessage(username string) string {
	escaped := escapeUsername(username)
	return "Welcome, " + escaped + "!"
}
```
